description: Add the ContactComment interface, state, loader, and collapsible JSX section to ContactSheet in OmnichannelInboxPage.tsx. This feature depends on FEAT-001 having created the SQL migration (the RPC call uses `as any` so TypeScript compilation is unaffected either way).
steps: Open c:\automacoes\C8 Control\src\pages\public-dashboard\OmnichannelInboxPage.tsx. Read the FULL file before making any changes.
Add `MessageSquare` and `ChevronDown` to the existing lucide-react import at the top of the file (they are not currently imported).
Add a new import block after the existing shadcn/ui imports: `import { Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent } from '@/components/ui/collapsible';`

Add the ContactComment interface near the other contact-related interfaces (around line 365, after OmniIdentity): `interface ContactComment { id: string; channel: string; post_id: string; post_url: string | null; comment_text: string | null; sender_username: string | null; commented_at: string; external_comment_id: string; }`

Inside the ContactSheet function, add three new state variables after the existing `igMeta` state (around line 395): `const [comments, setComments] = useState<ContactComment[]>([]);` / `const [commentsLoading, setCommentsLoading] = useState(false);` / `const [commentsOpen, setCommentsOpen] = useState(false);`

Add the `loadComments` useCallback after the existing `loadContact` useCallback (around line 430): `const loadComments = useCallback(async () => { if (!contactId || !clientId) return; setCommentsLoading(true); try { const { data, error } = await (supabase.rpc as any)('get_contact_comments', { p_contact_id: contactId, p_client_id: clientId, p_limit: 50, p_offset: 0 }); if (error) throw error; setComments((data ?? []) as ContactComment[]); } catch (err) { console.error('[ContactSheet] loadComments error:', err); } finally { setCommentsLoading(false); } }, [contactId, clientId]);`
Add a useEffect that resets comments state when the sheet closes: `useEffect(() => { if (!open) { setComments([]); setCommentsOpen(false); } }, [open]);`
Add a useEffect that triggers loadComments when commentsOpen becomes true: `useEffect(() => { if (commentsOpen) loadComments(); }, [commentsOpen, loadComments]);`

In the JSX inside ContactSheet's render, locate the closing `` of Seção 5 (Unificar cadastros) — it ends around line 882 with ``. Immediately after that `` and before the outer `` that closes `
`, insert the new Seção 6 JSX: a
containing a setCommentsOpen(v)}> with wrapping a styled button showing 'Comentários' with MessageSquare icon and ChevronDown (rotated 180deg when open using cn), and containing: (a) loading spinner when commentsLoading, (b) empty state text when comments.length === 0, (c) mapped comment cards showing sender_username, commented_at via formatMsgTimestamp(), comment_text, and a post_url link with ExternalLink icon, plus ChannelBadge for the channel. ExternalLink, cn, formatMsgTimestamp, and ChannelBadge are all already in scope.
acceptance_criteria: Running `cd "c:\automacoes\C8 Control" && npx tsc --noEmit` exits with code 0 and zero errors
The ContactSheet component renders without errors in the browser
The 'Comentários' collapsible section appears at the bottom of the ContactSheet after Seção 5
Clicking the 'Comentários' trigger expands the section and triggers loadComments (which calls get_contact_comments RPC)
When collapsed, the section shows only the trigger header
Empty state shows 'Nenhum comentário registrado' in italic when no comments returned
Comment cards show username, timestamp, comment text, post link, and channel badge
verification: cd "c:\automacoes\C8 Control" && npx tsc --noEmit — must exit with 0 errors
Confirm Collapsible, CollapsibleTrigger, CollapsibleContent are imported from @/components/ui/collapsible
Confirm MessageSquare and ChevronDown are added to the lucide-react import
findings: npx tsc --noEmit exited with code 0 (zero errors). Verified: MessageSquare and ChevronDown added to lucide-react import; Collapsible/CollapsibleTrigger/CollapsibleContent imported from @/components/ui/collapsible; ContactComment interface added after OmniIdentity; comments/commentsLoading/commentsOpen state added; loadComments useCallback added using (supabase.rpc as any); reset useEffect on sheet close added; trigger useEffect on commentsOpen added; Seção 6 JSX with Collapsible, loading spinner, empty state, and comment cards with ChannelBadge/ExternalLink/formatMsgTimestamp inserted after Seção 5.
